title: Block SIGRed with Palo Alto threat signatures
side_effects: A blocking action resets matching sessions on every rule using the profile, including false positives.
rollback: Remove the profile from the rule, or set the threat exceptions back to default.

title: Block BlueKeep with a Palo Alto threat signature

rollback: Remove the profile from the rule, or set the threat exception back to default.

title: Block Tomcat CVE-2025-24813 with Palo Alto threat signatures
side_effects: Signatures can't match encrypted payloads unless TLS is decrypted first.
rollback: Remove the profile from the rule, or set the threat exceptions back to default.

title: Stop and disable the Print Spooler
side_effects: Printing stops on this machine, locally and remotely.
rollback: Set the Print Spooler service back to automatic and start it.

title: Block DMZ traffic to the print server
side_effects: Nothing in the DMZ can reach this server, so printing through it from there stops.

title: Enable strict WinVerifyTrust signature checks
side_effects: Binaries with non-compliant signatures may show as unsigned.
